mechanism: Short-dated SPX option inventory can in principle require market makers to dynamically delta hedge in futures/underlying as spot moves; gamma determines how delta changes.
payer_or_forced_actor: Options liquidity providers carrying residual customer inventory would be the constrained hedgers, conditional on material net exposure.
candidate_expression_considered: Use observable short-dated option positioning/Greeks to infer the direction and intensity of required dealer hedge adjustment; no trading rule or threshold frozen.

public_documentary_sources.title: Volatility Insights: Much Ado About 0DTEs - Evaluating the Market Impact of SPX 0DTE Options
0DTEs Decoded: Positioning, Trends, and Market Impact

active_disconfirmation: Cboe reports customer SPX 0DTE activity is highly balanced and estimates net market-maker gamma hedging as de minimis relative to SPX daily liquidity.
Cboe reports no discernible broad market impact attributable to 0DTE option trading in its analysis.

A legitimate signal would require defensible point-in-time dealer inventory inference rather than gross option notional or open interest; public quote/Greek data alone does not establish dealer sign or residual net inventory.
The available Cboe DataShop quote/Greek product is a data-access path, but does not by itself solve participant-position attribution.
reason: The causal hedge channel is real in principle, but the bounded public evidence actively weakens the necessary premise of material net SPX 0DTE dealer hedging pressure, while point-in-time dealer inventory sign is not established by the identified public data surface. Freezing a directional CandidateHypothesis would therefore overstate mechanism evidence.
